answer_1.quote: We choose sentiment-controlled and topic-controlled text generation as the benchmark tasks... We ask annotators to rate these texts with a 1-5 Likert scale for each aspect.
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts conditioned on content prefixes and attribute labels (sentiment or topic).

answer_2.quote: We choose several state-of-the-art reference-free metrics as our baselines: Perplexity (PPL) ... DisScore ... UNION ... BLEURT ... BARTScore ... CTRLEval (Ours). We follow the existing work to adopt Pearson (r), Spearman (ρ), and Kendall (τ ) correlation coefficients between automatic metrics and human judgments to measure the performance of different metrics.

answer_3.quote: We utilize a pretrained model whose pre-training task is text in-filling (such as PEGASUS) as our base model, and fuse the generation probabilities from these "fill-in-the-blank" tasks as the evaluation result.

answer_4.quote: We collect human ratings on the generated texts from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT)... We ask annotators to rate these texts with a 1-5 Likert scale for each aspect.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated text on a 1-5 Likert scale for each evaluation aspect.
